slides.title: Django Authentication
slides.content:
# Authentication System 🔐

Django provides a complete authentication system out of the box!

## What you'll learn:
- **User Model** - Built-in User class
- **Login/Logout** - Authentication views
- **Permissions** - Authorization
- **Custom User** - Extending the User model

## Built-in Features

- ✅ User registration
- ✅ Login/logout
- ✅ Password hashing
- ✅ Password reset
- ✅ Session management
- ✅ Permissions and groups

> 💡 **Django hashes passwords automatically!** Never store plain-text passwords.

## Enable Authentication

```python
# settings.py (already included by default)
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    'django.contrib.auth',        # Auth framework
    'django.contrib.contenttypes', # Content types
    # ...
]
```

slides.title: User Model
slides.content:
# The User Model 👤

## Default User Fields

```python
from django.contrib.auth.models import User

# Built-in fields:
user.username
user.password      # Hashed!
user.email
user.first_name
user.last_name
user.is_active     # Account active?
user.is_staff      # Can access admin?
user.is_superuser  # All permissions?
user.date_joined
user.last_login
```

## Creating Users

```python
# Create regular user
user = User.objects.create_user(
    username='john',
    email='john@example.com',
    password='secretpass123'  # Hashed automatically
)

# Create superuser
User.objects.create_superuser(
    username='admin',
    email='admin@example.com',
    password='adminpass'
)
```

## User Methods

```python
user.check_password('secret')  # Verify password
user.set_password('newpass')   # Change password
user.save()                    # Save changes
user.has_perm('app.add_model') # Check permission
```

slides.title: Login & Logout
slides.content:
# Login and Logout Views 🚪

## Using Built-in Views

```python
# urls.py
from django.contrib.auth import views as auth_views

urlpatterns = [
    path('login/', auth_views.LoginView.as_view(), name='login'),
    path('logout/', auth_views.LogoutView.as_view(), name='logout'),
]
```

## Login Template

```html
<!-- templates/registration/login.html -->
<form method="post">
    {% csrf_token %}
    {{ form.as_p }}
    <button type="submit">Login</button>
</form>
```

## Settings

```python
# settings.py
LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL = 'home'      # After login
LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL = 'home'     # After logout
LOGIN_URL = 'login'              # Login page URL
```

## Custom Login View

```python
from django.contrib.auth import authenticate, login, logout

def login_view(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        username = request.POST['username']
        password = request.POST['password']
        user = authenticate(request, username=username, password=password)
        if user is not None:
            login(request, user)
            return redirect('home')
    return render(request, 'login.html')
```

slides.title: Protecting Views
Custom User Model
slides.content:
# Custom User Model 🛠️

Extend the User model for additional fields.

## Create Custom User

```python
# accounts/models.py
from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractUser

class CustomUser(AbstractUser):
    bio = models.TextField(blank=True)
    avatar = models.ImageField(upload_to='avatars/', null=True)
    phone = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True)
```

## Configure Settings

```python
# settings.py
AUTH_USER_MODEL = 'accounts.CustomUser'
```

## Reference User in Models

```python
from django.conf import settings

class Article(models.Model):
    author = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,  # Always use this!
        on_delete=models.CASCADE
    )
```

## Register in Admin

```python
from django.contrib.auth.admin import UserAdmin
from .models import CustomUser

admin.site.register(CustomUser, UserAdmin)
```

> ⚠️ **Create custom user BEFORE first migration!** Changing later is complex.
